key.name: display-duration-ms
key.description: How long noncritical notification banners remain visible, in milliseconds.

key.name: density
key.description: The spacing and size preset used by notification banners.

key.name: appearance
key.description: Whether banners follow the desktop color scheme or force a light or dark appearance.

key.name: position
key.description: Where notification banners appear on the primary display.

key.name: interruption-mode
key.description: How quickly queued noncritical notifications are shown.

key.name: click-to-expand
key.description: When enabled, hovering pauses the banner timer without expanding its details.

key.name: auto-expand-actions
key.description: Whether notifications with application-provided actions open with those controls visible.
